cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Acknowledge Our History
cards.instruction: Make someone recognize that the relationship, memory, or sacrifice mattered and cannot be treated as incidental.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Before you bin our ferry ticket, remember the overtime we worked for that weekend.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We missed the ferry. I hate being reminded.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. We stayed anyway. That was the first time we chose each other over a refund.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Keep the hotel receipt, then. That part was lovely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you write that on the envelope? In your handwriting, so it isn't just me saying it mattered.

mechanism: A carefully sorts and annotates travel keepsakes to make B acknowledge a meaningful shared weekend despite its failed ferry crossing.
confusable: D83 seeks correct recall; D81 asks the remembered sacrifice and connection be treated as valuable rather than incidental.
comparison: Photo alternative changes public account of a small harvest; receipt alternative captures B own acknowledgement on a private archive envelope.
seedUse: Overtime, missed ferry, staying weekend and hotel receipt derive from D81-b; S03 adds precise event classification and archival labelling.
